frame: Godot metres; X = east column direction, Z = south row direction, Y up; the site is at the origin at Y = 0
curvature_note: Y = height - site height - (X^2 + Z^2) / (2 x 1,737,400 m): the meshes follow the Moon's sphere, so the Horizons Sun/Earth elevations (relative to the site's horizontal) light the far terrain correctly
uv1: region 0..1, v = 0 at the north (z_min) edge: normal and AO maps
uv2: metres / 4 (one repeat per 4 m like the M1-35 regolith kit)
collision: terrain_heightfield.gd to_height_map_shape() on heightmap_<mpp>m_detail.r16 (hero) or heightmap_<mpp>m.r16; never the visual mesh
material: res://assets/environment/terrain/lola/terrain_lola.gdshader via lola_region.gd (object-space normal map, lunar-Lambert regolith)
normal_map_space: object space in this region's Godot frame (R = X, G = Y up, B = Z), curvature included; not a tangent-space map

ao_bake.use: darkens only the faint Earthshine/bounce fill; the Sun's light is never multiplied by AO
